Careers
Surecomp > Careers

Join our talent community

We thrive on creativity and diversity, on facing challenges and finding solutions. We foster collaboration, innovation and customer centricity. Above all, we are defined by who we are, we put our people first.

We are a truly global team, with over 300 employees, located in 16 different countries, speaking 25 different languages. We are proud of our established and dynamic company, our culture, our heritage and the pivotal shift we are driving in our collaborative approach to digital trade finance.

Surecomp is always on the lookout for talented and driven individuals who are ready to make a difference. If you are interested in joining our fabulous team, we’d love to hear from you

Our vision

Sustainable global trade promotes growth and improves people’s lives. The better the world trades, the better society is.

Our mission

To enable seamless, sustainable trade for everyone by removing barriers and facilitating collaboration.

Contact us

We use cookies to improve your experience on our website and to show you personalised content. You can allow all or manage them individually.

Cookie Overview

This website uses cookies so we can provide you with the best user experience possible. Cookie information is stored in your browser and performs functions such as recognising you when you return to our website and helping our team to understand which sections of the website you find most interesting and useful. You can adjust your preferences below.

Essential Cookies

Essential Cookies are enabled at all times so that we can save your preferences for cookie settings. These cookies do not collect any personal or sensitive information or IP addresses. Furthermore, the information they store is not sent to any 3rd parties.

Analytical Cookies

This website uses third party cookies such as Google Analytics to collect anonymous information, for example the number of visitors to the site, and the most popular pages. Keeping this cookie enabled helps us to improve our website.

Additional Cookies

This website uses the following additional cookies:

cf_bm - Vimeo - Cloudflare check for bot requests

vu_id - Vimeo - To store the users usage history

li_sgr - LinkedIn - Used to make a probabilistic match of a user's identity outside the Designated Countries - 90 days

bcookie - LinkedIn - Browser Identifier cookie to uniquely indentify devices accessing LinkedIn to detect abuse on the platform and diagnostic purposes - 1 year

lidc - LinkedIn - To facilitate data center selection - 24 hours

UserMatchHistory - LinkedIn - LinkedIn Ads ID syncing

AnalyticsSyncHistory - LinkedIn - Used to store information about the time a sync took place with the lms_analytics cookie

bscookie - LinkedIn - Used for remembering that a logged in user is verified by two factor authentication and has previously logged in

li_gc - LinkedIn - Used to store consent of guests regarding the use of cookies for non-essential purposes
